cefrAlignment: Matches C1 descriptors for speculating about causes, consequences and hypothetical situations and for qualifying opinions precisely ('degrees of certainty/uncertainty, belief/doubt, likelihood'); the modal perfects, 'the more…, the more…' and degree modifiers are C1-appropriate.
examFidelity: The IELTS Part 3 task (no prep, about 60 s) is accurate and the 129-word model fits; the TOEFL tag is supported only by a tip (no 45 s TOEFL practice task), and that tip now follows exams.ts (later interview questions move to wider issues) instead of making an unverified claim about question content.
fixes: Comparison gap '{{2}} lower' (previously flagged) now also accepts dramatically, vastly, noticeably and 'way'; the 'whereas' gap now also accepts 'but'
Fixed faulty comparisons: 'on a par with the public sector' → 'with pay in the public sector', and the gap text 'on a par with the city' → 'with those in the city'
Order exercise was ambiguous: 'It would seem that more younger workers are willing to change careers' was also a valid order. Replaced 'more willing' with 'keener', so only one order is possible

Certainty table: 'can't have' (almost certainly not) was listed as 'Unlikely'. Added an 'Almost certainly not' row (can't have / couldn't have / There's no way…), gave 'Unlikely' past forms 'probably didn't / I doubt that', and labelled 'could well' (a real possibility) and 'an outside chance' (a small one)
Replaced the double hedge 'may arguably be' (the lesson warns against piling up hedges) and paired the sweeping and hedged examples so they make the same claim

Model audio: 'The more people work remotely, arguably the more they value somewhere…' → 'Arguably, the more people work remotely, the more they value having somewhere…' so the structure being taught stays intact
Fixed the vocab example 'Their friendship was friendly but fairly superficial' (redundant) → 'Our conversations were polite but fairly superficial'
Reworded the TOEFL tip to follow exams.ts
openConcerns: There is no TOEFL-timed (45 s, no prep) speaking task despite the TOEFL tag; consider adding one or dropping the tag
learnerOutcome: A learner can signal how certain they are about future, past and hypothetical claims, hedge unprovable generalisations without sounding evasive, and say precisely how big a difference is.
